operators.customDisplayName: Load 2024_CSN_Data_Contributors.csv via pd.read_csv with default parameters (comma delimiter, header=0, UTF-8)

operatorProperties.code:
def process(contributors2024) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = contributors2024.copy()

    # Real header is on row index 2 in the loaded file (0-based)
    header = df.iloc[2].tolist()
    data = df.iloc[3:].copy()
    data.columns = header

    # Keep relevant rows: FTC web reports for years 2022-2024
    data = data[data['Year'].isin(['2022', '2023', '2024'])]
    data = data[data['Data Contributor'].astype(str).str.contains('FTC - Web Reports', na=False)]

    # Parse '# of Reports' like '796,366'
    reports = (
        data['# of Reports']
        .astype(str)
        .str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
        .str.strip()
    )
    data['reportsNumeric'] = pd.to_numeric(reports, errors='coerce')

    total = data['reportsNumeric'].sum(min_count=1)

    return pd.DataFrame([{'total_ftc_web_frauds_2022_2024': int(total) if pd.notna(total) else None}])

operators.customDisplayName: Re-interpret contributors2024 with true header row at original row index 2 (columns: Year, Data Contributor, # of Reports, %); filter Year in {2022,2023,2024} and Data Contributor contains 'FTC - Web Reports'; parse '# of Reports' by removing commas and converting to numeric; sum across years and return single-row DataFrame with total_ftc_web_frauds_2022_2024
